correctness.rationale: The construction is algebraically exact: k_i are distinct with uniform-population mean 3/2, W Pi k = W' Pi k =3 1 because u^T Pi k=0, and gamma_i=3/k_i-1 reduces every SIS equation on z=kx to x'=x(1-3x) with x(0)=1/5; unique global solution e^t/(2+3e^t). Both W matrices are positive symmetric within [0.1,4] and gamma,z0 satisfy the source admissibility bounds. Distinct z0 excludes any block-regular partition with fewer than n blocks. In n=2 Gram determinant vanishes precisely on stationary states or invariant rays P=Q=0, by positivity, ODE uniqueness and an affine ray tangency identity. The Gram double-integral determinant formula gives sharp T^4 and T^6 coefficients from exact first and second transverse jets. Independent rational assertions in verify.py for n=2,3,4,7,11,25 and two jet samples pass. Finite tests are not used as a universal proof; no noisy or stochastic conclusion is asserted.

originality.rationale: The motivating public 2025 SIS paper explicitly poses the false non-block-regularity equivalence as Conjecture 3.3 and reports an n=2 proof omitted. Its general Gram criterion already explains linear-algebraic underdetermination but not the exact nonstationary admissible exception. The 2022 Prasse--Van Mieghem surrogate result and 2022 Beaufort et al. diffusive symmetry classification do not supply this source-matched explicit contradiction or the sharp two-community invariant-ray observability/short-time formulas. Exact-phrase and semantic searches did not uncover another coverage result; this is not proof of global uniqueness. The novelty is narrow: constructive refutation and two-type classification, not generic low-rank surrogate theory.

value.rationale: The precise source conjecture asserts a parameter-visible condition for reconstructing epidemic contact weights; refuting its sufficient direction matters for inverse epidemiology, even in the smallest two-community case. The counterexample is nonstationary, strictly positive and uses distinguishable initial prevalences and recovery rates, so it cannot be dismissed as an equilibrium or trivial identical-community alias. The complete two-community P,Q criterion and exact Gram T^4/T^6 laws provide a substantive sharp diagnosis of observation loss and short-window conditioning. The counterfamily and classifications cover natural full parameter domains, not arbitrary unmotivated numerical slices.
